messages:
announce-bot: Quick heads-up: FRA1 (eu-frankfurt-1) will host a limited soft-open for a new Dedicated GPU offering: Strix-G700 (6x 64GB) in compact "preemptible-friendly" micro-pools. Soft-open starts Mon 2026-05-11 08:00 CEST. :loud_sound:
sylvie: (product) Pilot intent: gather perf & preemption behavior data for model families with high memory footprints. Invite-only for initial customers.
dmitri: (infra) Technical summary: G700 has asymmetric NVLink topology. We've implemented NUMA-aware allocator and a quick preempt checkpoint handshake to speed resumptions. Expected improvement: ~10-18% throughput on long sequences compared to prior gen.
harper: (ops) Scheduling policy: these micro-pools are marked preemptible-friendly. We'll prefer packing batch-inference and low-latency burst jobs into them. Preemption window is 2m warning + graceful checkpoint attempt.
ops: (ops) Important policy change for pilot: for Strix pilot pockets only, preemption credits are applied differently 12 preemptions per 30 days before escalation. See runbook.
billing-bot: Billing note (internal): preemptible usage billed at 55% of reserved rate when preempted within 24h of allocation; full-price applies if running beyond 24h without preemption. Reservations still billed as committed.
sales: (commercial) Sales will offer selected customers a 45-day pilot add-on and a discounted committed upgrade path for Strix pockets. Contact sales for seat invites.
sylvie: rollout schedule: 08:00 CEST soft-open, 48h reserved-priority window, then monitor for another week before expanding shared traffic.
dmitri: infra config snippet (ops reference):
```
pool: eu-frankfurt-strix-g700-pilot
node_type: strix-g700
pool_mode: compact-preemptible
priority_window_secs: 172800  # 48h
preempt_warning_secs: 120
checkpoint_timeout_secs: 30
fairshare_reserved: 220
fairshare_shared: 70
alert: capacity.strix.preempt_spill
```
oncall-bot: Oncall note: add alert group capacity.strix.preempt_spill to eu rotation for pilot. If spill > 8% sustained for 10m, escalate to oncall.
harper: ops action: enable preemption-credit accounting and add audit logs for all checkpoint attempts.
dmitri: infra action: push NUMA allocator + NVLink mapping to staging tonight; prod push tomorrow 03:00 CEST.
sylvie: CS action: we will notify invited accounts and provide guidance on checkpointing best-practices.
announce-bot: Docs: https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/strix-g700-frankfurt-pilot (internal) 12 do not externalize yet. Report regressions in #eng-runtime and tag @dmitri/@harper. :eyes:
